So always buy from big chain stores even if you have to pay higher making charge because they are fooling you at many places

featured_reviews.name: Matin Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
My family recently had a very unpleasant experience at Uttam Jewelers. The level of customer service here is extremely disappointing.

My Sister  visited the store after being informed that new jewellery designs were available. When she reached the store, the collection shown was mostly the same as before. When she politely raised this concern, instead of assisting her properly, the staff started arguing with her in front of other customers.

What was even more shocking was the behaviour of the owner. Rather than calming the situation, he spoke very rudely and openly stated that he does not want customers who purchase in smaller quantities. Such statements clearly show a lack of professionalism and respect towards customers.

A jewellery store runs on trust, relationships, and customer satisfaction. Unfortunately, this store failed in all three. No customer should be made to feel insulted or unwelcome for asking genuine questions.

Based on this experience, I would strongly advise others to be cautious before visiting this store.

featured_reviews.name: Aquib Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing and disturbing experience with Uttam Jewelers, Virar West. My wife visited the store after being informed over a call that new designs had arrived. She had previously visited and was told to come back once fresh collections were available.

However, when she visited again, the designs shown were mostly the same. When she politely questioned this, the staff began arguing with her in front of other customers instead of handling the situation professionally. What made the experience worse was the behaviour of the owner, who was present there.

Instead of resolving the concern, he started raising his voice and told her that they “do not want customers like you.” He also made comments suggesting that smaller purchases are not valued, which is extremely unprofessional and disrespectful. No customer deserves to be spoken to in such a manner, regardless of the purchase value.

Customer service and basic respect are fundamental in any business, especially in a jewellery store where trust and relationship matter a lot. Unfortunately, this store showed neither professionalism nor courtesy.

I strongly suggest management re-evaluates how customers are treated. Based on this experience, we would not recommend this store.

featured_reviews.name: Afreen Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Disappointed with the experience at Uttam Jewellers, Virar. Behavior seems to change based on purchase quantity. When buying 100g–200g, the service was excellent. But when purchasing just 3 grams and asking for a proper gold calculation breakdown, the attitude completely changed.

I was told that for 3 grams I was asking too many questions and making too many choices. The owner’s response felt dismissive and disrespectful. Asking for transparency in gold pricing is a basic customer right, regardless of the quantity being purchased.

Every customer deserves equal respect and professional behavior. Strongly not recommended
